data.name: Shamaail
data.long_meaning: Shamaail means dome or arch in Arabic. This name is derived from the Arabic word ‘Shamal’ which means ‘north wind’ and ‘Aal’ which means ‘house’ or ‘dome’. It symbolizes the idea of protection, enclosure, and stability. It is a name that conveys wisdom and knowledge.
